title: Guru Parampara
body:
Guru Parampara

In this section, we shall see the stories of the Purva-Acharyas (11.1) and the life story of Swami Ramanujar (11.2), and then the life story of Swami Desikan (11.3), and then try to map the lineage of gurus according to both the Tenkalai and Vadagalai Sampradayams (11.4).
